div.head: List of Persons
div.p: Editor’s Notes—The individuals identified below were principal participants in the events covered in this volume. Other officials and individuals not included in the list are identified in footnotes to the text at appropriate places. In general, individuals attending but not participating in meetings, and persons mentioned only in passing have not been identified. All titles and positions are American unless otherwise indicated. The editors have generally tried to avoid the repeated identification of “United Nations” when referring to its organs and committees. Where no dates are given, the individual held the position throughout the period covered by this volume. Spelling and alphabetization of names follow as closely as possible the style of official publications of the countries concerned.

note.p: During this period, the Sixth Regular Session of the United Nations General Assembly adjourned on February 5, 1952. The Seventh Regular Session opened on October 14 and adjourned on December 22, 1952, resumed on February 24, 1953, recessed on April 23, resumed again on August 17, and was formally closed on August 28. The Eighth Regular Session opened on September 15 and recessed on December 9, 1953. The Ninth Regular Session opened on September 21 and adjourned on December 17, 1954.
